pages.title: terror in backrooms valley
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Search for a way out of the Backrooms in this horror visual novel. Look for clues in yellow corridors, abandoned motels, and flooded tunnels. The survivors you meet and the decisions you make can change what you discover about the hidden valley and your own past.

pages.title: Prism Blast 3D
pages.creator: cong game
pages.description: Fit pieces onto a round board in Prism Blast 3D. Fill a ring or spoke to clear it and make room before gray junk closes in. Chain clears for combos, use power-ups when space gets tight, and tackle goals based on score, survival, or clearing junk.

pages.title: Water Flow Puzzle
pages.creator: QiGame
pages.description: Connect numbered pipe pieces to send water from the faucet into flasks in Water Flow Puzzle. Check the order in which the flasks need to fill and account for one-way valves, locks, and bombs as the puzzles develop. You can plan the route without a timer.

pages.title: Bloon Pop
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Rotate a frame to roll balloons toward a spinning saw in Bloon Pop. Use gravity to shift them, then change the angle to reach any that didn't move into the blade. Burst every balloon to complete the puzzle.

pages.title: Brainrot Mega Parkour
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Pick a course in Brainrot Mega Parkour and time your jumps around traps. Climb an endless tower, race across platforms, outrun a rolling lava ball, or escape rising lava. The four modes give you different hazards to read across the game's 40 handcrafted levels.

pages.title: Car Vs Zombies
pages.creator: AJAY AJ GAME DEV
pages.description: Drive through waves of undead in Car Vs Zombies. Ram zombies as they approach, then set up turrets to help defend the base. Keep an eye on which side the next group is coming from so you can move the car where it's needed.

pages.title: Red Hide Ball
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Arrange shields and obstacles to protect the balls in Red Hide Ball. Watch how each monster moves before deciding where to place a barrier. You have a limited number of moves, so find a setup that keeps the balls safe throughout the attack.

pages.title: Noob Ragdoll: Crazy Punch
pages.creator: GeekPlay
pages.description: Line up punches from the glove's point of view in Noob Ragdoll: Crazy Punch. Aim at the blocky characters and see where they fly when the punch connects. Try different glove skins as you work through the levels and get a feel for how the ragdolls react.

pages.title: Squid Game Original
pages.creator: DarkPlay
pages.description: Compete in a series of challenges inspired by Squid Game in Squid Game Original. Pay attention to the rules as each event begins, because the way you survive changes from one challenge to the next. Keep making it through until only one contestant remains.

pages.title: Bubble Up
pages.creator: MetalSail Studio
pages.description: Send small bubbles out to push BUB upward in Bubble Up. Use the left mouse button to launch them and change his course around obstacles. Help him rise past rooftops and keep going toward the sun.

pages.title: Mineblock Obby
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Jump through blocky obstacle courses in Mineblock Obby. Watch for traps and gaps as you look for a safe place to land. Collect coins along the way and use them to buy a new sword before taking on another course.

pages.title: Gun Craft Run Weapon Fire
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Keep moving and shooting in Gun Craft Run Weapon Fire. Pick up bullets and ammo packs as you run so the gun can keep firing. Watch the path for obstacles while you aim and decide which pickups you can safely reach.

pages.title: Real Freekick 3D
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Take turns shooting and defending in Real Freekick 3D. Choose a football team, then aim your penalties past the opposing keeper. When you switch sides, try to save the other team's shots. Win your way through the shootouts to reach the final.

pages.title: Island Battle 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Jump across a crumbling island in Island Battle 3D. Watch the surface as pieces break away, then knock rivals toward the gaps when you have an opening. Keep clear of the edges yourself and try to be the last jumper still on the island.

pages.title: Blob Bridge Run
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Pick up droplets of your own color in Blob Bridge Run. Use them to build bridges between platforms and get ahead in the race. Avoid traps and opponents that can scatter your droplets, and gather enough to make the next crossing.

pages.title: Poppy Time
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Find keys and get out of the house in Poppy Time. Search in the dark with Nicho and watch the timer while you try to stay out of the puppy's way. The decisions you make can lead to three different endings.

pages.title: Noob Stamp It
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Move a cube to collect color and stamp it onto the board in Noob Stamp It. Look at where you need to pick up paint before sending the cube to the stamp location. Work through 50 layouts as the routes change.

pages.title: Paint Island
pages.creator: Orosula Games
pages.description: Paint the capsules in Paint Island by sweeping a brush across them. Click to fix one arm in place and let the other sweep around it. Change the pivot when you need to reach another group, and keep going until every capsule is painted.

pages.title: Run Boys
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Race through obstacle courses in Run Boys. Jump, slide, and push past the other runners as you work your way through knockout rounds. Watch for hazards as you enter each new stretch, and try to stay in the race until the end.

pages.title: Handyman 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Take on construction jobs in Handyman 3D. Place bricks, clean paint buckets, or operate equipment according to the task in front of you. Complete each chapter's objective to move on to the next job.

pages.title: Cat Girl Fashion Challenge
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Choose outfits for different events in Cat Girl Fashion Challenge. Look through Cat Girl's wardrobe and decide what fits the occasion before entering each round. Compare her finished looks with the other contestants' outfits.

pages.title: Meow Meow Life
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Feed and look after a cat in Meow Meow Life. Spend time playing with your pet and check what it needs when you return to taking care of it. Switch between care and play as you get to know the cat.

pages.title: Island Bombing
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Wait for your ship to line up with an island in Island Bombing. Tap at the right moment to launch the missile, then watch for the next target. Keep timing your shots as you move across the ocean.

pages.title: Kick the Huggie Wuggie
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Try weapons on a ragdoll monster in Kick the Huggie Wuggie. See how it reacts to pistols, grenades, mines, or other tools. Collect coins as you play and use them to unlock more weapons and modes.

pages.title: Gangster Hero Grand Simulator
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Explore a city as a gangster in Gangster Hero Grand Simulator. Take a car or motorcycle through the streets and see how each handles as you move around the city. Switch vehicles when you want a different way to get around.

pages.title: Lost Treasure Slots
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Spin reels with treasure-hunt symbols in Lost Treasure Slots. Watch for combinations of three or more matching items to earn in-game coins. Each spin brings a new lineup to check for a winning match.

pages.title: Emoji Word Puzzle
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Work out the words hidden in emoji clues in Emoji Word Puzzle. Some levels ask you to read a group of emojis, while others give you the word and ask you to express it with pictures. Look at how the symbols work together before you answer.

pages.title: Parking Fury 3D
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Get cars into their marked spaces in Parking Fury 3D. Look for a way through the crowded city and watch for police as you drive. Give yourself room to turn into the parking space when you reach it.

pages.title: Jelly Island
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Swap pieces to make groups of three matching jellies in Jelly Island. Choose Time Attack to collect as many as you can before time runs out, or play the 25 story levels. Watch for special jellies and obstacles as the boards get harder.

pages.title: Unblock The Ball
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Slide wooden pipe pieces to make a path in Unblock The Ball. Other pipes stay put, so work out how to connect the movable pieces to the fixed ones. Guide the ball to the end and try to route it past the stars.

pages.title: Castel Wars New Era
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fight with industrial-era weapons in Castel Wars New Era. Try the new maps and gear, or see how long you last in Mayhem. In Zombie Mode, the attacks come from one direction. Play on your own or take on a second player.

pages.title: Jewels Mine
pages.creator: gamesforgame
pages.description: Swap gems to line up at least three of the same kind in Jewels Mine. Use larger combinations to create power-ups and clear more of the board. Build up your score and compare it on the global leaderboard.

pages.title: Mary Knots Garden Wedding Hidden Object
pages.creator: Origaming Media
pages.description: Help Mary turn a garden into a wedding venue in Mary Knots Garden Wedding Hidden Object. Find items in crowded scenes and sell things at a yard sale. Spend the money on garden decorations as you get the space ready for the wedding.

pages.title: Hospital Kissing
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Help a couple steal a kiss in Hospital Kissing. Watch the doctor and anyone else nearby, then choose a moment when they aren't looking. Stop before someone turns back and wait for another chance.

pages.title: Atari Asteroids
pages.creator: Atari
pages.description: Rotate and thrust your ship through a field of space rocks in Atari Asteroids. Shoot rocks into smaller pieces and watch for them to wrap around the screen. Keep moving when a saucer appears, especially the smaller one with the more accurate shots.

pages.title: Funny Haircut
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Give Daisy a new hairstyle in Funny Haircut. Work with the salon tools to change the shape of her hair and try a style that suits her makeover. Keep adjusting it until you're happy with how it looks.

pages.title: GP Ski Slalom
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Ski around the gates in GP Ski Slalom. Choose one of three skiers, including Santa, and steer through twelve increasingly difficult courses. Watch the next gate as you clear the current one and try to improve your time on each run.

pages.title: Puzzle Game Girls
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Put the pieces together in Puzzle Game Girls. Use shapes and picture details to see what fits, then join the sections you've completed. There are nine pictures to rebuild, each with a different set of details to look for.

pages.title: The Survivor
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Hold off waves of zombies and other creatures in The Survivor. Keep shooting as the enemies approach and take time between rounds to buy ammunition or improve your weapon. Use what you've earned to prepare for the next wave.

pages.title: Cute Girl Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a picture of Dora in Cute Girl Coloring Book. Pick a palette and fill in the drawing, trying different combinations on its details. Print the finished picture if you'd like a copy to share.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Golden Football
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Free the golden footballs in Bubble Shooter Golden Football. Aim shots at matching balls to clear the pieces around them. Hit a bomb when you want to remove the balls next to it, then look for another route to the footballs still on the board.

pages.title: Robot Fight
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Fight off robots and try to stay alive in Robot Fight. Clear every enemy robot to reach the next level. Look for friends you can collect for extra points while keeping track of where the other robots are coming from.

pages.title: City Scooter Ride Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Color scooter pictures in City Scooter Ride Coloring. Choose from eight images and use any of the 23 colors on their details. Save your finished picture when you want to keep it or move on to another design.

pages.title: Books With Numbers
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Compare the numbers in three books in Books With Numbers. Each book has a number the other two don't share. Scan across the lists to find the unique number in each one before the clock runs out.

pages.title: Golf Master
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Line up golf shots with the mouse in Golf Master. Check where the hole is and aim the ball toward the flag. Watch where it comes to rest, then adjust the direction of your next shot to get closer to the cup.

pages.title: Finger Painting
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Choose a color and paint with the mouse in Finger Painting. Use the brush to draw lines or fill parts of your picture, and switch colors as you work. Use the eraser to rework a detail before adding the finishing touches.

pages.title: StackBall.io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Break your way down a helix tower in StackBall.io. Send the ball through the platforms and watch how the sections line up as you descend. Make it all the way to the bottom to finish the level.

pages.title: Daily Mustang Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of Ford Mustangs in Daily Mustang Jigsaw. Choose easy, medium, or hard and use the shapes and car details to work out which pieces belong together. Try a harder setting when you want more pieces to sort.

pages.title: Demolition Monster Truck Army 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Take a monster truck into Demolition Monster Truck Army 2020 and put it through crashes and stunts. Use nitro when you want more speed, and upgrade the truck's wheels or try another vehicle. See how your changes affect the next run.

pages.title: Colorful Vehicles Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Flip tiles to reveal vehicles in Colorful Vehicles Memory. Remember where each one appeared and use that information to uncover matching pairs. Work through four levels and see whether you can clear the boards with fewer turns.

pages.title: Stunt Jeep Simulator : Impossible Track Racing Game
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Drive a jeep along tracks suspended in the sky in Stunt Jeep Simulator : Impossible Track Racing Game. Judge your speed before you reach the next bend or stretch of track. Keep the jeep on the course as you work through the high-altitude race.

pages.title: Highway Car Racing Game 3d
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Take a car onto the highway in Highway Car Racing Game 3d. Watch the traffic and steer through gaps as you build up speed. Earn cash and rewards to unlock more cars, then take a different one out on the road.

pages.title: Derby Destruction Simulator
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Ram other cars in Derby Destruction Simulator. Watch where your opponents are coming from and turn into a hit when you have room. Keep your own vehicle going as you try to wreck the others and survive the demolition derby.

pages.title: Fire Glow
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fire a glowing dot at the matching color in Fire Glow. Wait until the right segment lines up, then take the shot to break it. A hit on another color ends the run. Try Classic, Eliminate, Expand, or Origin to change the challenge.

pages.title: Halloween Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Drag jigsaw pieces into place in Halloween Jigsaw Puzzle. Use the edges and spooky details in the pictures to work out which pieces fit together. Join the sections you've built until the whole Halloween scene comes together.

pages.title: Merge Candy Saga
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Match three or more identical candies in Merge Candy Saga. Look for a move that brings the pieces together and clears them from the layout. After each match, scan the board again for another group you can make.

pages.title: Car vs Train
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Watch the railway crossings in Car vs Train as you drive through the city. Look for an opening between passing trains before moving into a crossing. Time your progress so the car can get through without meeting a train on the tracks.

pages.title: Match 3030
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Place colored block shapes in Match 3030 and look for ways to group matching colors. Drag a piece onto the board where it can help clear a match. Think about how much room the move leaves for the next shape.

pages.title: Funky Cube Monsters
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Match three identical cubes in Funky Cube Monsters to build your score. You can take your time, but each level gives you a limited number of moves. Look for matches that get you closer to the target score before you run out of steps.

pages.title: Stick Hero
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Grow a stick into a bridge in Stick Hero. Judge how far away the next platform is before you let the stick fall across the gap. If it comes up short, your character falls. Keep crossing to see how far you can get.

pages.title: Balls Rotate
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Rotate the maze to free the balls in Balls Rotate. Watch how they roll when you turn the layout, then change the angle to guide them through the next passage. Get the balls out of the maze to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Berries Jumper
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Click a berry platform to send the boy across in Berries Jumper. Look for solid footing before choosing where he'll land. Clicking an empty space makes him fall, but you can't wait too long either, so keep moving through the forest.

pages.title: Stickman Skate 360 Epic City
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Skate through the city in Stickman Skate 360 Epic City. Adjust your speed as you line up jumps and tricks, and watch for warriors along the route. Get through the levels and prepare to take on the boss.

pages.title: Crazy Pixel Apocalypse 3
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Fight through blocky maps in Crazy Pixel Apocalypse 3. Play a first-person match against other people online or choose a fight against computer-controlled characters and zombies. Change how you move and aim depending on who's coming after you.

pages.title: EG Solitaire King
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Move cards between the columns in EG Solitaire King. Look for moves that uncover face-down cards, then build the four suit piles as the right cards become available. Use a hint when you run out of ideas for the next move.

pages.title: Minicars Soccer
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Play soccer with cars in Minicars Soccer. Choose from seven vehicles with different handling and set the ball to one of three sizes. Look for bonuses on the field and use them to get ahead. The first player to score five times wins.

pages.title: EG Plane Evo
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Build an airline in EG Plane Evo. Buy planes and merge them to create better aircraft, then send them flying to earn money. Use the income to expand the fleet and decide which planes to merge next.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Inspired Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style a festive hairdo in Christmas Tree Inspired Hairstyles. Build a look around the shape and decorations of a Christmas tree, then try dress-up choices that go with it. See how the finished hairstyle looks with the holiday outfit.

pages.title: Accordion Solitaire
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description: Try to compress a full deck into one pile in Accordion Solitaire. Deal cards from the stock and move a pile onto the one immediately to its left or three places to its left when their top cards share a suit or rank. Think ahead before combining piles.

pages.title: Jack And The Beansteak Gold Rush
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Collect coins as Jack climbs the beanstalk in Jack And The Beansteak Gold Rush. Watch for obstacles farther up the stalk and move around them without missing the gold you can safely reach. See how far you can climb before a hazard stops you.
